verdict.rationale: 1Password's first-party Watchtower docs say it tells you about breaches, weak passwords, duplicate (reused) items, and other security problems with saved items. Release notes confirm Watchtower actively flags saved logins, here for passkey upgrades. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of exposed or compromised password checks such as known-leak lookup, detail on how proactive alerts and notifications are delivered, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Watchtower's breach warnings.
